Pause-Gamesflow

Pause-Games/flow/flow.flow

Flow's main facade for UI rendering, navigation, components, colors, logging, and hosted bottom sheets.

  • GitHub: Pause-Games/flow — pinned to 1.0.0
    1. Pick a release from Pause-Games/flow releases and add its Source code (zip) URL (or a packaged .zip asset, if the library ships one) to game.project under [project] dependencies, then Fetch Libraries in the Defold editor.
    2. Run bunx @defold-typescript/cli resolve to materialize its types.
    3. Import it under a namespace alias of your choice:

FlowNavigationMessages

FlowNavigationMessages.ids: FlowNavigationMessageIds

Map of all supported message ids keyed by operation name.

FlowNavigationMessages.PUSH: Hash | string

Message id for push; payload { id, params?, options? }.

FlowNavigationMessages.POP: Hash | string

Message id for pop; payload { result?, options? }.

FlowNavigationMessages.REPLACE: Hash | string

Message id for replace; payload { id, params?, options? }.

FlowNavigationMessages.RESET: Hash | string

Message id for reset; payload { id, params?, options? }.

FlowNavigationMessages.BACK: Hash | string

Message id for back; payload { result?, options? }.

FlowNavigationMessages.INVALIDATE: Hash | string

Message id for invalidate; no payload required.

FlowNavigationMessages.handle_message: FlowNavigationMessageModule['on_message']

Alias of on_message for older call sites.
